ev.q: This report describes two cases of encephalomyelitis in patients with monkeypox disease that occurred during the current U.S. outbreak.
CSF analysis demonstrated 155 white blood cells/ μ L (normal = ≤5)
Patients A and B had confirmed systemic MPXV infections with encephalomyelitis appearing within 5 and 9 days, respectively, of illness onset.
Two U.S. cases of encephalomyelitis associated with acute MPXV infection were identified during summer 2022.
